answer: Each agent drops a non-transferable saffron beacon into a shared lagoon of epoch challenges. The beacon is a short sequential hash chain rooted in its private key and the public nonce%3B any peer can verify it in seconds%2C yet spawning a thousand clones forces a thousand separate chains that cannot share the root. Agents that wander away from their own chain forfeit the deposit. A farm that splits one key still has every extra boat painted the same saffron%2C so the lagoon pays the lineage once and quietly sinks the duplicates.
